paragraphs.text: Ilvoro was a merfolk lullmage of Halimar with a Stonework Puma familiar who hired himself out as a guide across the Teeth of Akoum .

It was Ilvoro who discovered the runic prophecies of Ior Ruin and single-handedly lulled a tsunami just before it would have crashed into the Sea Gate . It was said he could calm a rampaging baloth with his voice alone. He was headed to the top of the peaks of Akoum and was hired by Sachir to guide Chandra Nalaar to Anowon 's camp for three gold coins. However, during their trek, he and Chandra encountered a roil tempest , and Ilvoro was killed.
